title: Embedded Lending Unit Economics Tool
description: Model embedded B2B lending unit economics: origination cost, APR, default rate, loss curve, cost of capital, servicing overhead. Outputs NIM, expected loss, RAROC, and Markdown unit economics memo. B2B commercial lending only. Client-side. Zero PII.
